notablePrerequisites: Any color besides "Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
description:
Cast Obscura Charm by paying {W}{U}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, copying Obscura Charm.
Resolve the copy of Obscura Charm, returning Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Naru Meha.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, copying Obscura Charm.
Repeat from step 4.
